description: JavaScript utility functions for handling party details, addresses, taxes, and contact info in ERPNext.

methods.name: erpnext.utils.get_party_details
methods.description: Fetches and updates party details based on form data, including address and payment terms.

methods.name: erpnext.utils.add_item
methods.description: Adds a new item row to the form if it is new and previous route indicates an item.

methods.name: erpnext.utils.get_address_display
methods.description: Retrieves and displays the address in a formatted manner.

methods.name: erpnext.utils.set_taxes_from_address
methods.description: Sets tax category based on address details.

methods.name: erpnext.utils.set_taxes
methods.description: Sets taxes for the form based on party and address details.

methods.name: erpnext.utils.get_contact_details
methods.description: Fetches contact details for the selected contact person.

methods.name: erpnext.utils.validate_mandatory
methods.description: Validates that a mandatory field has a value, throws error if not.

methods.name: erpnext.utils.get_shipping_address
methods.description: Retrieves shipping address details for the selected company.
